request.summary: Repaired product history promotion so only reduced projection items become canonical ConversationHistory rows; diagnostic, parse-gap, and unknown carriers remain internal staging/projection evidence. Added a token_usage_record regression fixture and assertions proving internal evidence is retained while product rows exclude diagnostic carriers. Re-ran the real Rust product flow and full Node collector regressions. On the physical Android device, restarted the local product-history service, obtained successful tail and older-page ACKs, and correlated one stable product tool item and nested field value with an expanded healthy IPC UI observation. Existing Android cache pollution remains retained by the explicit no-cleanup scope.
